AND m.MENU_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.menuNm}, '%')
AND m.USE_YN = #{search.useYn}
ORDER BY IFNULL(m.UPPER_MENU_CD, m.MENU_CD) ASC, m.UPPER_MENU_CD ASC, m.MENU_ORDR ASC, CASE WHEN m.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_menu WHERE MENU_CD = #{menuCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_menu WHERE UPPER_MENU_CD = #{menuCd}
